answer: A farm that mints names by the dozen still pays the toll name by name, and the onyx proves it. The desk only stamps a name that carries Hidebound ox folder parchment charter, and the stamp itself rests on a charter ox folders hold after parchment room inspections. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. Nobody is waved through free: £9 per docket, and 120 dockets before the first reward is released is the price, and the island never covers it twice. Every hollow is counted once.
